name: GoAction
tagline: Listens to conversations and turns them into drafted emails, to-dos and calendar meetings.
problem: Follow-ups and action items from conversations get lost.
solution: Transcribes speech, summarises it and has an agent create email drafts, tasks and meetings.
demo_moment: Team-described: after a talk, see the follow-up email already drafted.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 127 submissions.
Acts on conversations instead of only summarising them.

lessons: Agents that finish the task beat agents that summarise it.
